sections.title: A new kind of verb
sections.content: ismerkedik ("to get acquainted, to get to know each other") is built on ismer with a -kedik ending that gives it a reciprocal, back-and-forth feel — it's what two people do together, not just what one person does to another.

items.english: We get to know new people at work.
I make friends easily, because I'm friendly.

sections.content: ismerkedik is a plain -ik verb, conjugated exactly the way zuhanyozik and reggelizik already taught you back in A2 Unit 1 — no new endings, just a new -ik verb to add to the set.
